subject: TOURN: hidden challenges are publicly readable - phased reveal is cosmetic
description: visible is enforced for SCORING in ctfSubmitFlag (index.js:7018) but appears nowhere in firestore.rules, and challenges are 'allow read: if true'. An unrevealed challenge's title, description, hints, flagHash and flagSalt are readable by anyone unauthenticated. The scoring half was previously fixed after an exploit; the content half was not. Fix: gate challenge reads on visible, or accept that reveal is presentation-only and document it.
